scientific_integrity: The source eight-dimensional reduction and characteristic polynomial are prior work; the all-odd-dimensional exact projective aperiodicity conclusion is derived by a separate algebraic-integrality argument. Finite checker results are corroborative, not an infinite proof. Originality is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only the constant-spin-sign central harmonic invariant sectors; no classification of exceptional individual states, nonharmonic sectors, perturbed models or approximate revivals.
title: Exact parity dichotomy for projective revivals in harmonic spin-coupled Grover hypercube walks
